procedures.name: Access to Information request
steps: Address the request to the public entity holding the information.
Describe the information sought as specifically as you can.
State the form in which you would like to receive it.
Keep a dated copy of what you sent.

procedures.name: Service complaint to the county department
steps: Write to the responsible department describing what you observed and when.
Ask for a specific response — an inspection date, a status update, or a document.
If there is no reply, escalate to the Auditor-General.
